FG314.quote:
THE AWARD TO CARNEGIE ENDOWMENT FOR INTERNATIONAL PEACE IS A THREE-YEAR PROJECT WITH THE OBJECTIVE IS 
TO 
1) ESTABLISH A DIALOGUE ON THE GLOBAL DIMENSIONS OF NUCLEAR NAVAL PROPULSION, AND 2) CONDUCT AN 
ANALYSIS 
OF THE ECONOMIC IMPACTS OF PROLIFERATION.

FG324.quote: THE GLOBAL COMPETITIVE ANALYSIS AWARD PROVIDES COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS ASSESSING THE RELATIVE SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (S&T) COMPETITIVE BALANCE BETWEEN THE UNITED STATES AND MAJOR GLOBAL COMPETITORS.
